gloss: to give up on; to abandon; to see through

definitions.gloss: to give up on; to abandon; to write off
definitions.explanation: To conclude that something or someone is hopeless and decide to stop investing effort, money, or attention.

definitions.gloss: to see through; to judge fully; to size up
definitions.explanation: To assess something or someone completely and reach a decisive conclusion about their true nature or value.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{見切|みき}った。
examples.english: I gave up on that store.

examples.japanese: ⟦{在庫|ざいこ}→在庫：04701_zaiko⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{見切|みき}って⟦{安|やす}く→安い：00464_yasui⟧⟦{売|う}る→売る：00906_uru⟧ことにした。
examples.english: We decided to write off the inventory and sell it cheaply.

examples.japanese: ⟦{将来性|しょうらいせい}→将来性：22412_shouraisei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{見切|みき}って、⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{辞|や}めた。
examples.english: Having concluded there was no future in it, I quit the company.

examples.japanese: ⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{実力|じつりょく}→実力：03277_jitsuryoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{見切|みき}る。
examples.english: To size up the opponent's ability.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一瞬|いっしゅん}→一瞬：01805_isshun⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{敵|てき}→敵：03546_teki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{動|うご}き→動き：11926_ugoki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{見切|みき}った。

examples.japanese: ⟦{市場|しじょう}→市場：09685_shijou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{動向|どうこう}→動向：05580_doukou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{的確|てきかく}→的確：04536_tekikaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{見切|みき}る⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧。
examples.english: It's difficult to accurately gauge market trends.

notes:
A compound verb from ⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧ (to see) + ⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧ (to cut/complete). The ⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧ ending adds the nuance of doing something decisively or completely — here, seeing something through to a final conclusion.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: Transitive (⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧)
- No standard intransitive pair
- Pattern: X⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧Y⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{見切|みき}る

ASPECT (ている):
- Type: Telic (has endpoint)
- {見切|みき}って⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ = has given up on / has already judged

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {見切|みき}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧: to give up on; to cut one's losses (closely related set phrase)
- ⟦{在庫|ざいこ}→在庫：04701_zaiko⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{見切|みき}る: to write off inventory
- ⟦{見切|みき}り{品|ひん}→見切り品：07728_mikirihin⟧: clearance items; marked-down goods
- {見切|みき}り⟦{発車|はっしゃ}→発車：03694_hassha⟧: jumping the gun; starting before things are ready

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{諦|あきら}める→諦める：01813_akirameru⟧: to give up — focuses on emotional resignation; {見切|みき}る implies a more rational, decisive judgment
- ⟦{見極|みきわ}める→見極める：07171_mikiwameru⟧: to ascertain; to discern — focuses on carefully determining the truth; less decisive than {見切|みき}る
- {見限|みかぎ}る: to give up on; to abandon — very close synonym to sense 1, with a slightly stronger nuance of disgust or disappointment
